evals.prompt: 修复 CodeMirror 与 WKWebView bridge 的丢失消息问题；验证切换、撤销、IME 和保存。
evals.expected_output: Editor-integration owns the bridge and session correction, with source-fidelity, trust, or Xcode interaction verification added only for their distinct claims.
assertions: Traces the active session, document, revision, message ordering, and teardown lifecycle.
Keeps the full editor buffer authoritative and verifies reconciliation before save.
Uses isolated UI automation only for runtime-only interaction claims.

evals.prompt: 只把 YAML 的一个 property 改名并保持其他 Markdown 字节不变；不要改编辑器 bridge。
evals.expected_output: Routes to scholium-markdown-yaml-fidelity rather than editor integration because the owned boundary is exact source mutation.
assertions: Does not load the editor owner merely because the source may later be displayed in CodeMirror.
Uses targeted range mutation and exact unchanged-byte evidence.

evals.prompt: Review an editor selection [5,7) in normalized UTF-16 for exact source BOM + A + CRLF + emoji U+1F600 + e + U+0301 + CRLF + Z. A save helper writes normalized editor text. Calculate the exact source ranges and diagnose the save boundary.
evals.expected_output: Maps selection to exact-source UTF-16 [6,8) and UTF-8 [10,13); identifies normalization as source loss.
assertions: Separates normalized editor coordinates, exact UTF-16 source coordinates, and UTF-8 byte coordinates.
Requires byte-preservation assertions and the exact-source snapshot rather than normalized text.
